item.title: Circle receives OCC approval to establish Circle National Trust, the first crypto-native federal trust bank in the U.S.
Morgan Stanley receives preliminary OCC approval to establish a national trust bank for crypto custody and staking.
Stripe, Coinbase, BlackRock, Mastercard, and Visa launch Open USD, a new dollar-backed stablecoin network with 140+ partners.
UK HM Treasury launches tokenization taskforce of 50+ firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, and Morgan Stanley.
SEC prepares to propose rules on token offerings, broker-dealer crypto custody, and digital asset trading venues this month.
Galaxy Digital lowers CLARITY Act passage odds to 30% as Senate faces July 30 deadline to secure 60 votes before recess.
Bitcoin and Ethereum-linked protocols lose $35M across multiple bridge attacks within a six-hour window.
U.S. federal agencies miss GENIUS Act deadline for final stablecoin rules, one year after the law's enactment.
EU's MiCA transitional period ended July 1; European Commission opens public consultation on framework revisions through August 31.
DTCC pilots tokenized securities trades in July with full platform launch targeting October 2026, backed by 50+ Wall Street firms.
Ostium DeFi protocol loses $18M in USDC after oracle manipulation attack drains its Arbitrum liquidity vault.
Circle faces institutional backlash after $230M in stolen USDC crossed its bridge without being frozen.
EDX Markets raises $76M Series C led by SBI Holdings to expand institutional crypto trading and pursue a U.S. trust bank charter.
Europe's MiCA compliance costs are expected to drive a wave of mergers and acquisitions across the crypto industry.
